decisions.reason: As a small accessory that is related to our trailer business but less central than full vehicle lines, it offers weaker learning and scaling potential and is the most plausible candidate to be pruned.
A box car trailer series is very close to our existing knowledge base in trailers, and its repeated home-page prominence suggests enough strategic value to continue improving and selling it.
A car transporter trailer is still strongly related to our core capabilities, and with two years of market presence we would expect to learn and refine rather than withdraw it quickly.
A low-bed trailer series fits closely with established trailer engineering and customer relationships, so our absorptive capacity for further adaptation is high and withdrawal risk is low.
A high trailer cover series remains adjacent to our core product and manufacturing knowledge, making it worthwhile to retain while using market feedback to improve it.
This box car trailer series is highly aligned with our existing capabilities and was prominently marketed, so management would likely keep it unless later evidence clearly showed weak demand.
